AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 16, 2026
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Mark Christoffels, Chair  Katie Larson, Commissioner
Ryan Gales, Vice Chair  John Mosquera, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Marva Thomas, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner  Randy Zarn, Commissioner

  FINAL AGENDA

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55560  Recommendation to approve the minutes from the meeting of the Airport Advisory
  Commission on June 18, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55561  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB Business
  Partner Spotlight, featuring Sharif Faiz, Hertz General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55562  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding landing fees for aircraft
  utilizing Long Beach Airport and the impacts of implementing landing fees for
  general aviation aircraft.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55563  Recommendation to receive and file Monthly Airport Staff Reports for July 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Airport Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
